findings.title: The plot map shows free and taken plots, not a free plot offered to the next person on the waiting list

location.description: the Elm Row plot map in the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees which plots are free but not the step only Plotwise does, which is offering a free plot to the next person on the waiting list. The picture supports 'keeps the plots', not the headline's promise.

current.value: 12 plots, plots 3 and 8 marked Free, a Free/Taken key, no waiting list or offer shown

findings.target: The picture shows a free plot going to the next person in line, using only states and names the product really has.
findings.fix_direction: Show a free plot going to the next person in line, for example a short waiting list beside the map, with plot 3 marked as offered to the first person on it. The maker must supply the states and names; do not invent sample growers.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a fresh critic sees a waiting list or an offer to the next person on it in or beside the plot map, with no invented sample names.

findings.title: The March reminder and the week to say yes read as fixed product limits

location.description: the body text of the Rent reminders card

findings.viewer_experience: The Rent reminders card and the Plot offers card state 'one reminder before rent is due in March' and 'a week to say yes' as if they were fixed rules.

current.value: the copy reads as fixed rules

findings.target: The copy shows whether March and a week are examples or rules.
findings.fix_direction: The maker must say if they are examples or rules, then the copy must show which.

closed_when.check: In all four viewports, the Rent reminders and Plot offers copy shows whether the March reminder and the week to say yes are examples or rules.

findings.title: On phone the section heading leaves 'days' alone on its second line

location.description: the section heading above the four cards

findings.viewer_experience: 'days' sits alone on the second line, under a heading that otherwise reads as one phrase.
findings.target: 'work days' stays together on one line.
findings.fix_direction: Keep 'work days' together, for example with a non-breaking space between the two words, or set the heading slightly tighter at this width.

closed_when.check: In the phone image, 'days' is not alone on a line of h2.

findings.title: On tablet the plot map card ends well short of the cards below it

location.description: the plot map card in the hero on tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The card ends at about x 491 while the cards below run to x 736, so the right edge is ragged. This was the same before the fixes.

current.value: card ends at about x 491; cards below end at x 736

findings.target: The card runs the full content width or matches a card column.
findings.fix_direction: Let the card run the full content width, or match a card column.

closed_when.check: In the tablet image, the plot map card ends at the same right edge as the cards below it, or matches a card column.
